ui.tagline: Find the help each person in your family may qualify for — under the rules in effect today.
ui.pointPrivacyBody: Your answers stay on this device and disappear when you close the page. No account. No tracking.
ui.pointPeopleBody: In California, help often belongs to each person. A child may qualify even when a parent does not.
ui.pointSourcesBody: See the official rule, the date it started, and when we last checked it.

programs.calfresh: Money for groceries each month, on an EBT card.
programs.cfap: State food aid for some immigrants who can't get CalFresh.
programs.calworks: Monthly cash aid and job help for families with children.
programs.wic: Healthy food and nutrition help for pregnant people, new parents, and children under 5.
programs.early-learning: Free preschool and early learning for young children.
programs.sun-bucks: Grocery money in the summer for school-age children.
programs.capi: Monthly cash for older, blind, or disabled immigrants who can't get SSI because of immigration status.
programs.covered-california: Health insurance you buy, often with help paying each month.
programs.california-lifeline: A discount on home or cell phone service.
programs.metro-life: Free and discounted rides on LA Metro buses and trains.
programs.sce-care-fera: A discount on your Southern California Edison electric bill.
programs.socalgas-care: A discount on your SoCalGas gas bill.
programs.ladwp-ez-save: A discount on your LADWP bill.
programs.bwp-lifeline: A lower electric rate from Burbank Water and Power.
programs.glendale-care: A monthly discount on your Glendale Water & Power electric bill.

rules.mc.child: Children under 19 can get full Medi-Cal if family income is at or below 266% of the poverty level. Immigration status does not matter for children.
rules.mc.pregnancy: People who are pregnant or had a baby in the last year can get full Medi-Cal if family income is at or below 213% of the poverty level, regardless of immigration status.
rules.mc.adult: Adults who are U.S. citizens or have a green card can get full Medi-Cal if household income is at or below 138% of the poverty level.
rules.mc.humanitarianFederal: Refugees, asylees, and parolees can get full Medi-Cal if household income is at or below 138% of the poverty level.
rules.mc.humanitarianState: Federal funding for refugees', asylees', and parolees' Medi-Cal ended October 1, 2026. California pays for their full Medi-Cal until June 30, 2027.
rules.mc.otherLawful: Some other immigration statuses can get full Medi-Cal. It depends on your exact status — the county or a legal aid group can tell you.
rules.mc.uisBeforeFreeze: In 2024 and 2025, adults could get full Medi-Cal regardless of immigration status if household income was at or below 138% of the poverty level.
rules.mc.uisEnrolled: Adults without satisfactory immigration status who already have full Medi-Cal can keep it if they renew on time.
rules.mc.uisEnrolled2027: Adults without satisfactory immigration status who already have full Medi-Cal can keep it, with fewer dental benefits and a monthly premium for some ages.
rules.mc.restricted: Since January 1, 2026, new adult applicants (19 and older) who are undocumented can get restricted Medi-Cal: emergency care and pregnancy care.
rules.mc.restrictedHumanitarian: Starting July 1, 2027, refugees, asylees, and parolees are scheduled to move to restricted Medi-Cal (emergency and pregnancy care).
rules.cf.citizen: U.S. citizens can get CalFresh if household income is at or below the limit for your household size.
rules.cf.lprChild: Children under 18 with a green card can get CalFresh with no waiting period.
rules.cf.lpr5: Adults who have had a green card for 5 years or more can get CalFresh.
rules.cf.lprDisabled: Green card holders with less than 5 years may still get CalFresh if they receive disability payments.
rules.cf.humanitarianBefore: Before April 1, 2026, refugees, asylees, and parolees could get CalFresh.
rules.cf.humanitarianRenewal: Since April 1, 2026, refugees, asylees, and parolees cannot get CalFresh as new applicants. If you get it now, it continues until your next renewal.
rules.cf.otherLawful: Most other statuses cannot get CalFresh, but a few can (for example, Cuban or Haitian entrants and citizens of Micronesia, the Marshall Islands, or Palau).
rules.cfap.lpr: Adults with a green card for less than 5 years can't get CalFresh yet, but they can get the same help from California's CFAP.
rules.cfap.humanitarian: Most refugees, asylees, and parolees who lost CalFresh in 2026 cannot get CFAP either. Some, like survivors of domestic violence, still can. Ask the county.
rules.cfap.age55: California plans to open CFAP to people 55 and older, regardless of immigration status, starting October 1, 2027, if the state funds it.
rules.cw.child: Children who are citizens or qualified immigrants can get CalWORKs cash aid if family income is below the limit, even if their parents cannot.
rules.cw.pregnant: Pregnant people with low income can get CalWORKs.
rules.cw.caretaker: Parents and caretakers of children can get CalWORKs cash aid if family income is below the limit.
rules.wic.eligible: Pregnant people, people who had a baby in the last year, and children under 5 can get WIC if income is at or below the limit — or if they already get Medi-Cal, CalFresh, or CalWORKs.
rules.el.headStart: Children ages 3 and 4 can go to Head Start for free if family income is at or below the poverty level, or if the family gets CalWORKs or SSI.
rules.el.earlyHeadStart: Babies, toddlers under 3, and pregnant people can join Early Head Start if family income is at or below the poverty level, or if the family gets CalWORKs or SSI.
rules.el.statePreschool: Children ages 3 and 4 can attend California State Preschool if family income is at or below the state limit.
rules.el.upTo130: Some spots are open to families with income up to 130% of the poverty level. Ask your local program.
rules.sun.eligible: School-age children can get SUN Bucks if family income is at or below 185% of the poverty level, or if the family gets CalFresh or CalWORKs.
rules.capi.eligible: Immigrants who are 65 or older, blind, or disabled, and can't get SSI only because of their immigration status, can get CAPI if income is below the payment level.
rules.cc.withHelp2025: In 2025, people with lawful status who earned too much for Medi-Cal could get help paying premiums at any income.
rules.cc.withHelp: People with lawful status who earn too much for Medi-Cal can buy a plan, with help paying if income is up to 400% of the poverty level.
rules.cc.withHelp2027: From 2027, federal law limits help paying premiums to citizens, green card holders, and a few other groups.
rules.cc.fullPrice: Anyone with lawful status can buy a Covered California plan. Above 400% of the poverty level, there is no federal help with the cost.
rules.ll.eligible: Your household can get California LifeLine if income is at or below the limit, or if anyone gets Medi-Cal, CalFresh, CalWORKs, SSI, or WIC.
rules.life.eligible: LA County residents can get LIFE if household income is at or below the limit, or if they get CalFresh, Medi-Cal, SSI, or CalWORKs.
rules.care.sce: SCE customers can get CARE if household income is at or below 200% of the poverty level, or if anyone gets CalFresh, CalWORKs, Medi-Cal, SSI, or WIC.
rules.care.fera: Households with income a little above the CARE limit (up to 250% of the poverty level) can get FERA.
rules.care.socalgas: SoCalGas customers can get CARE if household income is at or below 200% of the poverty level, or if anyone gets CalFresh, CalWORKs, Medi-Cal, SSI, or WIC.
rules.ezsave.eligible: LADWP customers can get EZ-SAVE if household income is at or below the limit. You don't have to send proof of income to apply.
rules.bwp.eligible: Burbank Water and Power customers can get Lifeline if household income is at or below 200% of the poverty level, or if anyone gets CalFresh.
rules.gwp.eligible: Glendale Water & Power customers can get Glendale Care if household income is at or below 200% of the poverty level, or if anyone gets SSI.

notes.mc.anyStatusKids: Children keep full Medi-Cal no matter their immigration status. The 2026 changes do not apply to children.
notes.mc.postpartum12: Coverage continues for 12 months after the baby is born.
notes.mc.mcap: If income is a little higher (up to 322% of the poverty level), the Medi-Cal Access Program may cover pregnancy care for a small fee.
notes.mc.assetTest: Since January 1, 2026, Medi-Cal counts savings and property again for people 65+ or with a disability. Ask the county about the current limit.
notes.mc.workRules2027: Starting as early as January 2027, some adults 19–64 may need to show work, school, or volunteering to keep Medi-Cal. Many people are excused.
notes.mc.humanitarianChange2027: This is scheduled to change on July 1, 2027, when coverage may become restricted to emergency and pregnancy care. Check again before then.
notes.mc.freezeComing: Starting January 1, 2026, new adult applicants without satisfactory immigration status can only get restricted Medi-Cal.
notes.mc.renewOnTime: Return your renewal forms on time. If coverage ends, you may only be able to come back within 3 months.
notes.mc.dentalEnds2027: Routine dental care for adults in this group is scheduled to end July 1, 2027 (emergency dental continues). This date was moved from July 2026.
notes.mc.premiums2027: A monthly premium is planned from July 1, 2027 for ages 19–59 (now set at $30 a month; the amount may change).
notes.mc.noRoutineDental: Routine dental care is no longer covered for adults in this group. Emergency dental care is still covered.
notes.mc.premiumsNow: A monthly premium applies for ages 19–59 (at least $30 a month). Ask the county for the current amount.
notes.mc.restrictedCovers: Restricted Medi-Cal covers emergency care, labor and delivery, and pregnancy care.
notes.mc.scheduledMayChange: This change is scheduled but could still change before it starts.
notes.cf.applyForKids: You can apply for your children without applying for yourself. Only the people applying need to share immigration information.
notes.cf.workRules: Since June 1, 2026, some adults 18–64 must work, train, or volunteer about 20 hours a week to keep CalFresh longer than 3 months. Parents of children under 14 and others are excused.
notes.cf.elderlyDisabledRules: Because someone in your home is 60+ or disabled, different income rules apply. Costs like rent and medical bills may still let you qualify.
notes.cf.hr1Coming: On April 1, 2026, a federal law (H.R. 1) ended CalFresh for new applicants who are refugees, asylees, or parolees.
notes.cw.childOnly: This can be a "child-only" case: the county gives aid for the child, and the parent does not have to qualify.
notes.cw.workRules: Adults in CalWORKs usually take part in job training or work activities (Welfare-to-Work).
notes.wic.noStatus: WIC does not ask about immigration status.
notes.wic.until5: Children can get WIC until their 5th birthday.
notes.el.noStatus: Head Start does not require immigration papers. Federal courts blocked a 2025 attempt to add status checks.
notes.sun.automatic: Most children who get CalFresh, CalWORKs, or Medi-Cal get SUN Bucks automatically — no application needed.
notes.sun.yearly: SUN Bucks has run every summer since 2024. Dates for summer 2027 have not been announced yet.
notes.capi.ssiFirst: You usually must apply for SSI first and be turned down because of immigration status.
notes.capi.sponsor: If someone sponsored your green card, their income may count.
notes.capi.savings: Savings must be under $2,000 for one person or $3,000 for a couple.
notes.cc.cliff: Extra federal help ended after 2025. Above 400% of the poverty level, you get no help paying premiums.
notes.ll.onePerHome: One discount per household — for a home phone or a cell phone.
notes.life.everyone: Each rider in your household can sign up for their own LIFE TAP card.
notes.ezsave.seniors: If someone is 62+ or disabled, ask LADWP about its Lifeline program, which gives a bigger discount.
notes.bwp.buss: If your income is higher, ask about the BUSS program (about 14% off electric).

where.metroLife: Online at metro.net/life or by phone
where.utility: Directly with your utility company, online or by phone
